name: Swara Baby Products
summary: Swara Baby Products, backed by FirstCry parent Brainbees Solutions, is a contract manufacturer of disposable hygiene products such as baby diapers, based in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh. Revenue grew from ₹767 cr in FY24 to ₹1,212 cr in FY26, and profit rose 18.5% in FY26 to ₹95.6 cr, though the net margin is down from about 12% in FY24 to about 8%. Borrowings grew faster than revenue to ₹443 cr, with debt to equity at 0.81; about ₹128 cr of the ₹500 cr fresh issue goes to repaying debt and about ₹198 cr to a new project. The RHP cut the issue to ₹800 cr with a ₹300 cr offer for sale, and the price band was not yet announced when this was written, so valuation checks are not available.

fh1.finding: Revenue rose from ₹766.6 cr (FY24) to ₹1,212.4 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 25.8%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹766.6 cr, ₹959.7 cr, ₹1,212.4 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was 0.81 at 31 March 2026.

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose 70% (₹260.1 cr to ₹443.1 cr) while revenue rose 58% over FY24–FY26.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹319.4 cr, ₹399.9 cr, ₹553.2 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow for FY26 was not found in public sources.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax rose about 18.5% in FY26, to ₹95.6 cr from ₹80.7 cr.

pr2.finding: Net margin fell from about 12.3% in FY24 (PAT ₹94.0 cr on ₹766.6 cr) to 8.2% in FY26.

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 17.28% in FY26 (ROE 20.06%).

pr5.finding: No listed peer comparison was found; one source says there are no listed peers.

va1.finding: The price band has not been announced, so the post-issue P/E cannot be computed.

va2.finding: The price band has not been announced, so the post-issue price to book cannot be computed.

va3.finding: The price band has not been announced, so market cap to sales cannot be computed.

pg1.finding: Promoters hold 100% before the issue; the post-issue holding was not found.

pg2.finding: Information on any pledge of promoter shares was not found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: Information on regulatory action against promoters was not found.

is1.finding: The offer for sale is up to ₹300 cr of the ₹800 cr issue in the RHP, about 37.5%.

is2.finding: The price band and post-issue market cap have not been announced.

is3.finding: Selling shareholders' average acquisition cost was not found.

up1.finding: ₹198.2 cr of the ₹500 cr fresh issue (about 40%, just under the line) is for capex on a new project.

up2.finding: ₹127.5 cr (about 26%) of the fresh issue repays borrowings of the company and its subsidiaries.

up3.finding: The amount for general corporate purposes was not stated.
